paragraph: In 2024 [GEODATA's cadastre, holding 450,000 urban parcel boundaries, was linked to the registry offices' system](<https://www.esri.com/en-us/lg/industry/government/stories/angola-modernizes-land-administration-gis-cadastre-management>). Esri says GEODATA implemented the property registration system in all 22 registry offices in all 18 provinces. [Government spokesman Paulo Tecas announced a digital platform built with the tax authority AGT](<https://novojornal.co.ao/politica/detalhe/executivo-promete-legalizar-40-mil-imoveis-ate-ao-final-de-2026-71209.html>), which is to register 40,000 properties by the end of 2026. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says land can be searched or registered online. Mature would need land searches, title applications or transfers to be made online.

The land directorate DTFCN runs [a Building Permit System for first titles and a Property Management System for transfers, corrections and mortgages](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/burundi-s-land-services-go-digital-with-new-integrated-platform>). The 2025-2026 Finance Law [required every titleholder to apply for a secure electronic land title](<https://burundi-eco.com/titres-fonciers-electroniques-securises-entre-avancee-technologique-et-inquietudes-sociales/>). In the last twelve months, [the 2026-2027 budget law moved the deadline to 31 March 2027](<https://cn-law.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/EN-Budget-Law-2026-2027-CN-Law.pdf>). In July 2026 the Prime Minister [launched a census of urban owners to build a digitised, geo-referenced land register](<https://abpinfo.bi/2026/07/16/lancement-officiel-du-recensement-des-proprietaires-des-proprietes-ou-parcelles-dans-les-centres-urbains-du-burundi/>), starting in six towns. No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

On 6 November 2026 the project chief of the land agency ANDF [put its national cadastre at 643,993 parcels in 12 communes, 3 of them fully covered](<https://fraternite.bj/terra-benin-et-ppmec-ii-pour-accelerer-la-securisation-fonciere/>). In the last twelve months, Parakou [had 196,474 parcels registered by September 2026](<https://matinlibre.com/2026/09/04/cadastre-a-parakou-196-474-parcelles-enregistrees-les-pays-bas-saluent-les-avancees/>). In July 2026 ANDF said [E-TERRE takes certain land procedures online](<https://academie-sciences.bj/actualite/tribune-de-haut-niveau-des-experts-du-numerique-et-du-foncier>). In November 2026 the government launched TERRA BENIN, which [aims to register 1.5 million parcels, starting in 14 communes](<https://www.gouv.bj/article/3734/modernisation-fonciere-benin-deux-nouveaux-programmes-accelerer-deploiement-cadastre-national/>). No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

The tax directorate [launched SYC@D, a cloud platform for cadastre, state domain and land, on 21 March 2025](<https://www.sidwaya.info/foncier-au-burkina-sycd-pour-une-meilleure-gestion-des-terres/>), after [a one-month pilot at Ouagadougou land offices](<https://www.horonyafinance.com/burkina-dematerialisation-des-actes-administratifs-la-direction-generale-des-impots-lance-lapplication-sycd-pour-une-phase-pilote-dun-mois/>). The Ministry of Economy and Finance says [users can apply for plot allocation online through SYC@D](<https://www.finances.gov.bf/forum/detail-actualites>). In the last twelve months, in September 2026, [SYC@D managed the cadastre, state domain and land, with FasoSign signing provisional cession orders](<https://cfinance.news/article/burkina-fasomodernisation-de-ladministration-publique-le-premier-ministre-lance-la-plateforme-fasosign-pour-boucler-la-boucle-de-la-dematerialisation/>). No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

In October 2025 [the deeds registry was still largely manual](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/90382>), and only the Gaborone registry prints deeds. In the last twelve months, in August 2026, the Assistant Minister of Lands told Parliament that [Land Board officers across the country process Secure Land Title transactions on the web-based Land Information System](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/92827>). [The 2026/27 budget funds a four-year upgrade of the system](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/89882>). No source found since October 2023 says land can be searched or registered online. Mature would need land searches, title applications or transfers to be made online.

On 8 April 2024 UNDP and the finance ministry [signed a US$1.6 million agreement supporting the e-cadastre pilot](<https://oubanguimedias.com/2024/04/14/le-pnud-et-le-gouvernement-centrafricain-signent-un-accord-de-1-6-millions-de-dollars-pour-le-projet-de-digitalisation/>). The UNDP representative said the pilot is an electronic land management system. It is to digitise the cadastre service, [which is kept on paper](<https://oubanguimedias.com/2024/04/14/le-pnud-et-le-gouvernement-centrafricain-signent-un-accord-de-1-6-millions-de-dollars-pour-le-projet-de-digitalisation/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a digital land register is in service. Establishing would need a digital title register, cadastre or land information system in service for part of the country.

[The finance ministry's Livre Foncier Electronique lets notaries consult land titles](<https://finances.gouv.ci/gouvernance-et-reformes/fiscalite-interieure>). In February 2025 LoGRI said [the construction ministry's SIGFU is digitising all existing paper maps](<https://logri.org/2025/02/expanding-the-property-tax-base-innovations-in-property-identification-and-challenges-in-cote-divoire/>), and that applications for land titles can be made online through it. In the last twelve months, in October 2026, the director of the Cadastre said [the tax administration's e-Cadastre platform is dematerialising cadastre procedures step by step](<https://www.koaci.com/article/2026/10/09/cote-divoire/societe/cote-divoire-journees-foncieres-le-cadastre-numerique-au-coeur-de-la-reforme-fiscale_201459.html>). No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

The budget directorate says [no commune had a digital cadastral plan in 2024](<https://www.dgb.cm/mindcaf-engager-les-reflexions-pour-la-mise-en-oeuvre-progressive-de-la-digitalisation-des-procedures-foncieres/>), against a target of 0.25. In the last twelve months, in June 2026, the urban development ministry [sought a firm for a land information system for Yaoundé and Douala](<https://www.armp.cm/details?id_publication=6404&type_publication=AMI>). [A September 2026 call under the same World Bank project covers supervising that work](<https://armp.cm/details?id_publication=6610&type_publication=AMI>). The 2026 finance bill [proposes FCFA 874 million for a programme whose aim is a digital national cadastre](<https://rfp.cm/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/PROJET-DE-LOI-FINANCES-2026_FR_26112025.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says a digital land register is in service. Establishing would need a digital title register, cadastre or land information system in service for part of the country.

In December 2025 [a UN-Habitat study found digitisation still embryonic](<https://drcongo.un.org/fr/308407-des-donn%C3%A9es-fonci%C3%A8res-pour-orienter-les-choix-techniques-institutionnels-et-financiers-la>), with under 15% of plots holding a legal document. In the last twelve months, in June 2026, the land ministry said [a pilot is making digital archiving work in seven Kinshasa land districts](<https://www.affairesfoncieres.gouv.cd/actualites/rdc-le-gouvernement-adopte-le-plan-foncier-national-2026-2040-tournant-historique-pour-la-gestion-des-terres>). On 20 November 2026 the land minister told the Council of Ministers that [digitisation had identified 1,822,051 land files, 14.8% of them digitised](<https://www.congojournal.com/articles/13827/rdc-plus-de-1-8-million-de-dossiers-fonciers-identifies-seulement-14-8-numerises>). No source found since October 2023 says a digital land register is in service. Establishing would need a digital title register, cadastre or land information system in service for part of the country.

The state-domain directorate said in November 2025 that [field patrols starting in Brazzaville will feed a national digital register of state land](<https://congolive11.com/ngouedy-makita-transparence-fonciere-en-marche/>). Each parcel and building is to be geolocated, photographed and given a unique number. [The patrols are to extend step by step to the twelve departments](<https://congolive11.com/ngouedy-makita-transparence-fonciere-en-marche/>). The directorate expects close to 35,000 titles to be issued or updated by the end of 2026. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a digital land register is in service. Establishing would need a digital title register, cadastre or land information system in service for part of the country.

In February 2024 an opinion piece said [the country had no national online land register](<https://www.habarizacomores.com/2024/02/les-litiges-fonciers-et-les-arnaques.html>). It urged that land registers be digitised. In the last twelve months, in April 2026, the head of the Cartography Unit said [a land information system is being set up as a national priority](<https://fr.linkedin.com/posts/nair-aboubacar-2265a092_un-moment-historique-pour-les-comores-au-activity-7449676142535692288-noIc>), with World Bank funding. The unit was training in GIS at the regional mapping centre in Nairobi. No source found since October 2023 says a digital land register is in service. Establishing would need a digital title register, cadastre or land information system in service for part of the country.

A joint order of 17 March 2025 [declared the island of São Vicente a cadastred area](<https://boe.incv.cv/Bulletins/DownloadAct?id=74399>), following a project that built a property rights information system and cadastred Sal, Boa Vista and Maio. [Mindelo was declared cadastred on 19 March 2025](<https://www.governo.cv/cidade-do-mindelo-declarada-area-cadastrada/>). In the last twelve months, in October 2026, the minister put [national cadastral coverage at about 33%](<https://www.inforpress.cv/en/article-11888>), and survey work resumed in Tarrafal and São Salvador do Mundo. No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

[The director general said in March 2025 that the database covers 217 land conservations across the country](<https://www.lnr-dz.com/2025/03/11/un-livret-foncier-electronique-sous-forme-de-carte-electronique-en-2025/>). Users [request the land booklet and cadastral extracts online and pay by card](<https://www.algerie360.com/fadaeldjazair-livret-foncier-cadastre-en-ligne/>) on the Fada El Djazair portal. In the last twelve months, [Decree 26-15 of 7 January 2026 created the electronic land booklet](<https://ecotimesdz.com/numerisation-prestations-cadastrales-livret-foncier-electronique/>). On 11 January 2026 the national domain directorate [generalised Amlak, one system with a central database for cadastre, land conservation and state domains](<https://algerie-eco.com/2026/01/27/algerie-publication-dun-decret-officialisant-la-mise-en-place-du-livret-foncier-electronique/>). In November 2026 La Sentinelle reported that in Guelma [rural cadastre is complete and urban cadastre about 98%](<https://lasentinelle.dz/index.php/2026/11/04/guelma-cadastre-et-conservation-fonciere-accelerent-leur-mue-numerique/>).

[The property registry's New Alamein office is linked by a digital hub to the New Urban Communities Authority](<https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContentMulti/549747/Multimedia.aspx>). In July 2025 [the Prime Minister opened the link in 16 registry offices in the new cities](<https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/2/549747/Egypt/Society/Egypt-PM-inaugurates-Real-Estate-Registry-and-Nota.aspx>). In the last twelve months, in October 2026, [the justice ministry launched a network linking the property registry with four ministries and the survey bodies](<https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/10/28/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%AF%D9%84-%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B5%D9%84-%D8%AA%D8%B7%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86%D8%B8%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%AC%D9%8A%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%84%D9%83%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%B1%D8%A8%D8%B7-%D8%B4%D8%A8%D9%83%D9%89-%D9%85%D8%B9/7597491>). No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

No stage is set. Nothing has been found since October 2023 that says whether land rights in Eritrea are registered digitally. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source has been found that says land rights are recorded on paper, or that they are not recorded. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says land rights are recorded on paper or not recorded.

[The eLand platform runs digital registration, transfers and title records in Bishoftu, Adama and Shagar](<https://land.et>). In Addis Ababa [more than 700,000 land titles had been digitised by March 2024](<https://addisfortune.news/south-korea-funds-land-title-digitisation-in-four-cities>). The Ministry of Agriculture describes NRLAIS as [a central computer record of rural land transactions and ownership](<https://www.moa.gov.et/e-services/>). In the last twelve months, Finland reported that [certificates had been issued for 34 million parcels in 562 woredas by the end of June 2026](<https://um.fi/results-of-development-cooperation/-/asset_publisher/o2A1dCQquJyC/content/miljoonille-etiopialaisille-oikeus-omaan-maahan/35732>). No source found since October 2023 says one digital register covers rural and urban land across the country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

In May 2026 Gabon's cadastre and digital economy ministers met to speed up [the digitalisation of the cadastre and land procedures](<https://agpgabon.ga/gabon-foncier-acceleration-de-la-digitalisation-du-cadastre/>). In the last twelve months, [work begun on 5 May 2026 under the Gabon Digital programme aims to modernise the cadastre](<https://agpgabon.ga/gabon-digitalisation-le-gouvernement-echange-avec-le-snedai/>). In September 2026 the government [signed a memorandum with SNEDAI for a land registry pilot in Estuaire, Greater Libreville included](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/gabon-steps-up-land-registry-overhaul-with-greater-libreville-pilot>). The Gabon Connect calendar [expects ePropriété, the land-book service, in September 2027](<https://gabonmediatime.com/digitalisation-le-gouvernement-annonce-le-deploiement-progressif-de-gabon-connect/>). No source found since October 2023 says a digital land register is in service. Establishing would need a digital title register, cadastre or land information system in service for part of the country.

The Lands Commission [runs its records on ELIS after scanning and geo-referencing them](<https://www.eis.africa/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/THE-DIGITAL-TRANSFORMATION-OF-GHANA_S-LANDS-COMMISSION-BENJAMIN-QUAYE.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [a digital service unit in Ho brought it to the Volta Region in June 2026](<https://www.graphic.com.gh/news/general-news/digital-client-service-access-unit-inaugurated-at-volta-regional-office-of-lands-commission.html>). In July 2026 the Lands Minister said [the public can apply online for official land searches in the nine regions where ELIS runs](<https://www.graphic.com.gh/news/general-news/lands-commission-targets-one-month-land-registration.html>). In October 2026 the Executive Secretary said [ELIS is operational in Greater Accra and nine other regions](<https://gna.org.gh/2026/10/lands-commissions-digital-reform-gamechanger-for-land-administration-in-ghana/>). No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

On 24 November 2025 the urbanism ministry's secretary general said [the system for issuing land titles has been digitised](<https://mosaiqueguinee.com/2025/11/guinee-la-digitalisation-du-titre-foncier-met-fin-aux-ventes-multiples-dun-meme-terrain-sg-muh/>). He said a parcel can no longer be titled twice. In October 2025 [the government began mapping state farmland in four regions](<https://www.agronewsguinee.net/2025/10/reforme-fonciere-lancement-de-la-cartographie-des-terres-agricoles-en-guinee/>), which is to feed a future rural land platform. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country, or that land can be searched or registered online. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

The Gambia's land policy for 2026-2035 [names the absence of a central land information system and of cadastral data](<https://policies.gov.gm/f/6d4b253b-ef9d-11f0-b086-029254d29bb1>). In the last twelve months, in January 2026, [nine firms bid for the National Land Information System](<https://gambiana.com/land-reforms-gather-pace-as-government-weighs-new-agency-and-sweeping-changes/>). On 9 November 2026 the ministry said [its alpha version is complete and in testing](<https://senigambia.com/ministry-updates-public-on-national-land-policy-implementation/>). A firm is setting up a centre to scan old land records. No source found since October 2023 says a digital land register is in service. Establishing would need a digital title register, cadastre or land information system in service for part of the country.

[ArdhiSasa is the government's digital platform for land information and land services](<https://www.kenyans.co.ke/news/127225-ardhisasa-goes-down-again-users-warned-disrupted-land-services>). In August 2026 the Lands PS said [it runs in Nairobi, Murang'a, Mombasa Island and Isiolo](<https://radiogeneration.co.ke/why-ardhisasa-expansion-has-fallen-behind-ps-korir_43436>), and the Auditor-General found only Nairobi and Murang'a fully migrated, of 83 registries. In the last twelve months, an outage from 1 September 2026 held up the work of advocates on the platform, [the Law Society of Kenya says](<https://eastleighvoice.co.ke/news/396368/lsk-demands-urgent-restoration-of-ardhisasa-platform-amid-land-transaction-delays>). No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

In October 2025 [the Liberia Land Authority signed a three-year MOU to develop the Liberia Land Information System](<https://lla.gov.lr/index.php/publications/news-article/item/65-liberia-land-authority-and-south-korean-partners-signed-landmark-mou-to-develop-liberia-land-information-system>), with a pilot planned in Montserrado and Margibi. In the last twelve months, [over 12,000 properties in Nimba County were mapped for a national cadastre](<https://frontpageafricaonline.com/liberia-land-authority-launches-real-property-valuation-training-in-nimba-ushering-in-digital-era-for-land-governance/>) by February 2026. A Swedish-funded project [digitised the Monrovia Atlas and 232 archived maps](<https://liberianinvestigator.com/swedish-funded-land-reform-project-strengthens-liberia-land-governance/>) before closing in June 2026. No source found since October 2023 says a digital land register is in service. Establishing would need a digital title register, cadastre or land information system in service for part of the country.

In September 2022 [the Ministry of Justice said real-estate e-archiving was complete for the north and south Tripoli administrations](<https://aladel.gov.ly/home/%d9%85%d8%b9%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%8a-%d9%88%d8%b2%d9%8a%d8%b1%d8%a9-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b9%d8%af%d9%84-%d8%aa%d8%b4%d8%a7%d8%b1%d9%83-%d9%85%d8%b5%d9%84%d8%ad%d8%a9-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%aa%d8%b3%d8%ac%d9%8a%d9%84/>). [In January 2024 the ministry said electronic archiving of the Real Estate Registration Authority's work had reached about 85% in some branches](<https://alwasat.ly/news/libya/425506>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a digital land register is in service, or that land can be searched or registered online. Establishing would need a digital title register, cadastre or land information system in service for part of the country.

Land Equity International said in March 2025 that [Community Council land allocation records are still kept by hand and often lost](<https://www.landequity.com.au/news/land_registration_lesotho_ntsebo/>). [The councils are not linked to the Land Administration Authority](<https://www.landequity.com.au/news/land_registration_lesotho_ntsebo/>), which issues leases, the strongest title. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says whether the Authority's registration is digital. Preparing would need titles being digitised, or a digital cadastre or land information system under way in some areas.

[ANCFCC states it holds 7.7 million land titles and 260 million land and cadastral documents digitised](<https://www.ancfcc.gov.ma/chiffrecles/>), and that digital cadastral maps cover the national territory. [Notaries have consulted its electronic database since 15 January 2024](<https://medias24.com/2024/01/17/documents-fonciers-la-consultation-en-ligne-desormais-ouverte-aux-notaires/>). ANCFCC states that 86% of its 3 million users are online, including 76% of notarial deed filings and 95% of certificates issued. No change has been found in the last twelve months. [Its board forecast 2,000,000 digital property certificates in 2025](<https://www.ancfcc.gov.ma/media/ametop/Communiqu%c3%a9%2025%20decembre%202024%20VF.pdf>).

[A kiosk at the Tana-ville land office has issued registration certificates and plans from dematerialised records since 7 July 2025](<https://www.produir-madagascar.mg/lancement-du-distributeur-automatique-dinformation-au-sein-de-la-circonscription-fonciere-de-tana-ville-et-remise-de-materiel-pour-lapipa/>). [The land ministry said in April 2025 that its land information system would roll out in five pilot regions](<https://newsmada.com/2025/04/17/mdat-deploiement-progressif-du-systeme-dinformation-fonciere/>). In the last twelve months, in January 2026, Newsmada wrote that [land records still rest on old, often damaged archives](<https://newsmada.com/2026/01/23/madagascar-coree-du-sud-la-digitalisation-du-foncier-comme-levier-strategique-de-developpement/>). No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

[One million Bamako parcels had been digitised by March 2024](<https://www.maliweb.net/habitationsparcelles/problematique-de-la-gestion-du-foncier-letat-a-la-recherche-de-solutions-perennes-3058808.html>). [A land information system and one-stop land office was presented in March 2025](<https://www.ortm.ml/digitalisation-de-ladministration-deux-nouvelles-plateformes-de-modernisation-lancees>), to run in Bamako's six communes. In the last twelve months, a July 2026 review of the land reforms says [over 1.5 million parcels in Bamako, Kati and several towns have a unique cadastral number](<https://www.maliweb.net/habitationsparcelles/gestion-fonciere-et-domaniale-le-bilan-des-reformes-phares-de-la-transition-3118561.html>). No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country, or that land can be searched or registered online. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

[The World Bank found SIGIT, the land information system, operational when its project closed in 2024](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099041025095533783/txt/P164551-e911de3f-ad72-4e08-b0e6-7bbb6c628183.txt>), with 1,283,171 land use rights recorded. [Nampula registered 44,706 properties between February and May 2025](<https://ikweli.co.mz/2025/05/13/14621/>), and [Beira scanned and registered 40,000 plots into a new database](<https://partnersforwater.nl/news/beiras-land-registry-the-key-to-the-system-change-that-will-support-a-climate-resilient-city/>). An MCC evaluation found that [in 2023 many land offices still relied on paper](<https://www.mcc.gov/resources/doc/evalbrief-052824-moz-land-tenure-regularization/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

[The Administration Générale des Domaines says it registers all contracts digitally on the Lagoud platform for real estate documents](<https://fr.madar.mr/actualites/mauritanie-procedures-pour-faciliter-lenregistrement-des-contrats-a-travers-une-plateforme-numerique/>). In the last twelve months, in January 2026, [the land directorate said citizens can now access their secured land documents, starting in Nouakchott and then regional capitals](<https://www.ami.mr/archives/250018>). The land minister said LEEGOU services will reach all 54 moughataas by 2027. [Kassataya's opinion column says the government has a project to digitise the cadastre](<https://kassataya.com/mauritanie-le-numerique-comme-instrument-de-depossession-silencieuse-du-foncier/>). No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

The government's list of operational systems, dated November 2024, [names the Land Administration and Valuation Information Management System (LAVIMS)](<https://cib.govmu.org/Documents/Reports/List%20of%20Operational%20Systems.pdf>) of the housing and land ministry. The Registrar General [calls its e-Registry System the platform for land and property registration](<https://registrar.govmu.org/rgd/index.php/upcoming-projects/>). In the last twelve months, in May 2026, the ministry [tendered consultancy for LAVIMS 2.0](<https://housing.govmu.org/Communique/Clarification%20No%201.pdf>), to be linked to the Registrar General's systems. The listing does not say which land offices use the system. No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

[Malawi launched LIMS in February 2024](<https://itweb.africa/article/malawi-reviews-digital-land-workflows/rW1xLv5ngAp7Rk6m>), a web system linking Lands, Surveys and Physical Planning. In June 2025 [the ministry launched LIMS in Blantyre to replace paper records of land transactions](<https://www.247malawi.com/malawi-takes-a-leap-forward-in-land-management-with-digital-platform/>). In the last twelve months, in August 2026, the minister said [a land audit matched paper files against the records in LIMS](<https://malawicables.com/speech-by-minister-of-lands-chimwemwe-chipungu-on-the-land-ownership-audit/>). In October 2026 he said [hackers had breached the system, which holds title deeds](<https://www.nyasatimes.com/minister-chipungu-reveals-hackers-targeted-malawis-land-database/>). No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

[NCLAS 1 was rolled out to all Communal Land Boards in 2008](<https://www.fig.net/resources/proceedings/fig_proceedings/fig2024/ppt/ts02g/TS02G_mazambani_12660_ppt.pdf>), and the ministry introduced web-based NCLAS 2 in 2014. In May 2023 a FIG paper said [the cadastral LIS had crashed the year before](<https://www.fig.net/resources/proceedings/fig_proceedings/fig2023/papers/ts08i/TS08I_MABAKENG.pdf>) and was being redeveloped. By then [NCLAS had registered over 193,000 communal land rights, all mapped and digitised](<https://www.fig.net/resources/proceedings/fig_proceedings/fig2023/papers/ts08i/TS08I_MABAKENG.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

[The urbanism minister said a single cadastre is being built through the E-Cadastre project with ANSI](<https://www.lesahel.org/entretien-avec-le-ministre-de-lurbanisme-et-de-lhabitat-le-colonel-major-abdoulkadri-amadou-dresse-le-bilan-des-reformes-et-des-chantiers-en-cours/>), financed by the World Bank. In the last twelve months, in March 2026, ANSI [sought equipment for the national data centre to host the platform](<https://www.nigertenders.com/tender/acquisition-equipment-which-will-be-installed-national-datacenter-host-e-cadastre-platform-83605d0.php>). In 2026 it also [sought a firm to collect cadastral data on a 15,000-plot pilot site at Bangoula](<https://www.nigermarches.com/appel_d_offre/recrutement-dun-cabinet-consortium-charge-de-la-collecte-des-donnees-cadastrales-et-urbanistiques-numeriques-georeferencees-sur-le-site-pilote-des-15-000-parcelles-de-bangoula/>). No source found since October 2023 says a digital land register is in service. Establishing would need a digital title register, cadastre or land information system in service for part of the country.

Lagos State's [e-GIS portal went live in January 2024 with the state's digitised land titles and records](<https://businessday.ng/life/article/lagos-revolutionises-land-acquisition-as-sanwo-olu-launches-automated-application-portal/>). In March 2025 the housing minister said [over 90 per cent of land is unregistered and untitled](<https://www.thisdaylive.com/2025/03/20/with-300-billion-in-dead-capital-fg-plans-digitisation-of-land-information-system-nationwide>). In the last twelve months, [the 360Lands registry in Cross River had processed 330 title and consent applications by June 2026](<https://guardian.ng/technology/tech-firm-to-tackle-delays-in-c-of-o-processing/>). In June 2026 the minister [inspected a federal Centralised Land Repository built ahead of its launch](<https://guardian.ng/news/fed-govt-reaffirms-commitment-to-digitalization-of-land-administration/>). No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

[The Ministry of Environment says every land record is now kept in a digital registry](<https://www.environment.gov.rw/news-detail/rwanda-launched-electronic-land-registration-certificate-system>). It says land transactions that need no notary are fully online through Irembo. [Over 10 million paper titles were converted to digital form in 2023](<https://www.houseinrwanda.com/news/digital-land-titles-are-changing-land-ownership-and-verification-rwanda>). More than 866,000 e-titles have been downloaded. The National Land Authority lists [a National Registry system, LAIS, with a spatial database](<https://www.un.org/globalgeospatial/sites/default/files/2026-04/rwanda_land_administration_case_study_unggkic.pdf>). In the last twelve months, in October 2026, the Scorecard said [LAIS is linked to IFMIS, the Rwanda Revenue Authority and Irembo, putting 12 land services online](<https://www.ktpress.rw/2026/10/why-rwanda-is-unhappy-with-only-11-of-government-services-fully-digitised/>).

In August 2025 the Registrar General of Lands [ordered registry offices to check paper records against the electronic record](<https://almndranews.com/71664/>) first. [Registries had closed when armed groups took parts of four states](<https://almndranews.com/71664/>). Some records were lost. In the last twelve months, in October 2026, an Omdurman registry employee said [the office checks ownership in an electronic database](<https://3ayin.com/real-estate-ownership-dispute-/>) and keeps backup copies. No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. None says land can be searched or registered online. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

On 21 November 2025 the World Bank [counted 351,899 occupancy titles recorded in the land information system](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099122125122530674/pdf/P172422-ab8683a5-9e88-4886-8cab-aa59ce4e604d.pdf>), with no municipal land office yet working on it. In the last twelve months, in June 2026, PROCASEF said [830,000 parcels are mapped in 138 communes and 128 land offices built for SIFCOM](<https://aps.sn/securisation-fonciere-le-procasef-plaide-pour-une-reforme-denvergure-nationale/>). [SIFCOM was in preproduction in 55 communes at 30 June 2026](<https://procasef.com/comite-de-pilotage-du-procasef-des-resultats-historiques-salues-et-un-ptba-2026-revise-adopte/>). No source found says a land office works on SIFCOM. Establishing would need a digital title register, cadastre or land information system in service for part of the country.

In February 2024 [land and house ownership was recorded by hand](<https://sierraloaded.sl/feature/what-biometric-property-agreement/>). [A World Bank report of October 2024 found no land rights yet recorded under the Land Administration Project](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099102924175012156/pdf/P177031-6773547a-5b87-4c2c-9ac7-3f49fd446856.pdf>). In July 2025 the Ministry of Lands said [a firm was building a land management information system](<https://www.un.org/globalgeospatial/sites/default/files/2026-05/5.jobo_samba.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [a boundary harmonisation pilot ended in March 2026](<https://ayvnews.com/government-concludes-boundary-harmonisation-pilotsets-stage-for-nationwide-land-title-registration/>). In June 2026 the minister said [an online portal will let anyone verify ownership records](<https://moice.gov.sl/civic-day-london-minister-of-lands-highlights-major-reforms-in-land-sector/>). No source found since October 2023 says a digital land register is in service. Establishing would need a digital title register, cadastre or land information system in service for part of the country.

In 2025 the World Bank said that [the municipal land registries of Baidoa and Garowe registered each plot with GIS](<https://worldbank.org/en/news/feature/2025/05/21/371-000-households-in-somalia-find-respite-from-drought-afe>) for resettled families, who received title deeds. [The Nagaad project resettled 1,150 families in Baidoa and 1,000 in Garowe](<https://worldbank.org/en/news/feature/2025/05/21/371-000-households-in-somalia-find-respite-from-drought-afe>). The Ministry of Public Works runs it with the municipalities of Garowe, Baidoa and Mogadishu. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country, or that land can be searched or registered online. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

In Western Bahr el Ghazal [the lands ministry kept two paper register books in November 2024](<https://www.radiotamazuj.org/en/news/article/weak-land-tenure-system-aggravates-conflicts-in-w-bahr-el-ghazal>). [A policy expert called the national registration system manual in June 2025](<https://www.onecitizendaily.com/index.php/2025/06/18/digital-land-register-key-in-fighting-fraud-expert/>). [FAO sought a consultancy in September 2025 to develop a Land Information System for South Sudan](<https://www.ungm.org/Public/Notice/279257>). In the last twelve months, in July 2026, [Central Equatoria said engineers are building a unified digital land registration system, starting with Juba County](<https://www.onecitizendaily.com/index.php/2026/07/08/central-equatoria-state-advances-digital-land-registration/>). No source found since October 2023 says a digital land register is in service. Establishing would need a digital title register, cadastre or land information system in service for part of the country.

No stage is set. Nothing has been found since October 2023 that says whether land rights in Sao Tome and Principe are registered digitally. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source has been found that says land rights are recorded on paper, or that they are not recorded. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says land rights are recorded on paper or not recorded.

The Deeds Registry says that [since 1995 it has kept no manual land, debts or miscellaneous contract registers](<https://gov.sz/index.php/departments-sp-623334762/deeds>). [Its page, read in August 2026, says the information is computerised, retrievable within seconds and updated daily](<https://gov.sz/index.php/departments-sp-623334762/deeds>). In August 2025 Registrar of Deeds Nozipho Vilakati said [Eswatini is working towards a fully electronic system for registering and storing deeds](<https://web.archive.org/web/20251116190816/https://lands.go.ke/eswatini-delegation-returns-kenya-benchmarking-lands-digitization>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

[The domains directorate put its E-Conservation system into production on 2 October 2023](<https://atpe.td/actes-fonciers-la-conservation-electronique-est-lancee/>), with the first 5,000 secured deeds. In the last twelve months, the land ministry signed with [Géo Consult in December 2025](<https://atpe.td/modernisation-fonciere-le-ministere-de-lamenagement-du-territoire-signe-un-accord-avec-geo-consult/>). [A parcel and land-right recording pilot was set for N'Djamena's 7th district and rural Linia in March 2026](<https://www.kadaster.com/-/from-cocreation-to-action-in-chad>). In November 2026 the Cadastre director said [regularisation files are checked in the GIRAF database and archived digitally](<https://tchadinfos.com/2026/11/08/foncier-au-tchad-la-regularisation-pour-prevenir-les-conflits/>). No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

In September 2024 [land title procedures were fully dematerialised](<https://www.republiquetogolaise.tg/tic/1609-9722-services-publics-zoom-sur-les-reformes-initiees-pour-accelerer-la-digitalisation>), and [every parcel has had a unique number since August 2024](<https://www.togofirst.com/fr/gouvernance-economique/2605-16413-togo-operation-de-mise-a-jour-des-anciens-titres-fonciers-non-georeferences>). In the last twelve months, on 3 December 2025, [contractors delivered the full digitisation of the land books](<https://lomegazette.com/transformation-numerique-au-togo-lotr-et-le-pagdsp-saluent-lexcellence-operationnelle-de-cagecfi-et-sesa-technologies-lors-de-la-reception-des-livres-fonciers-numerises/>), and the land directorate had stopped manual titles two weeks before. In May 2026 the tax office [sought a firm to build the modules of its land information system](<https://www.afdb.org/en/documents/ami-togo-recrutement-dun-cabinet-charge-du-developpement-de-lapplication-du-systeme-dinformations-du-foncier-sif-loffice-togolais-des-recettes-otr-pagdsp>). No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

[The land registry office ONPF says consulting titles, certified copies and ownership searches can already be done remotely](<https://news.gnet.tn/vers-une-administration-sans-papier-la-propriete-fonciere-tunisienne-passe-a-la-vitesse-numerique/>). [The minister says ONPF services are delivered online through cpf.gov.tn](<http://www.domainetat.tn/?p=14628>), including certificates of ownership and registration. [The cadastre office signed a USD 50m contract with a Samsung-led consortium in May 2025](<https://www.webmanagercenter.com/2025/05/26/546769/tunisie-lancement-du-projet-de-systeme-dinformations-foncieres-avec-un-consortium-sud-coreen-mene-par-samsung-ct/>) for a land database and cadastral system. In the last twelve months, in November 2026, the state domains minister said [a cadastral geoportal is to be finished within two years](<https://www.lapresse.tn/2026/11/07/terres-domaniales-11-000-hectares-mis-a-la-disposition-des-societes-communautaires/>).

In the last twelve months, on 30 October 2026, the Lands PS said [e-Ardhi is operational in 17 regions, with land records kept in a central digital register](<https://www.ippmedia.co.tz/the-guardian/news/local-news/read/tanzania-targets-nationwide-rollout-of-e-ardhi-land-system-by-june-2027-2026-10-30-124103>). [The deputy minister told Parliament's lands committee the same on 21 October](<https://www.lands.go.tz/news/kamati-ya-bunge-yasisitiza-wananchi-kuelimishwa-umuhimu-wa-hatimiliki-za-ardhi>). The Lands PS set a target of e-Ardhi in every region by June 2027. A Ruvuma lands official said [citizens can sign their title deed through e-Ardhi from any region](<https://www.tanzaniainvest.com/construction/e-ardhi-digital-land-system>). No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

In October 2025 the Lands PS said [more than 1.5 million titles had been digitised](<https://www.newvision.co.ug/category/news/ugandans-abroad-welcome-digitalisation-of-lan-NV_221485_102026>). In the last twelve months, Uganda's finance ministry said [UgNLIS was operational in 22 zonal offices in March 2026](<https://doingbusiness.finance.go.ug/reforms/expand-ugnlis-to-all-land-offices-by-2026>), with expansion to all land offices in progress. In August 2026 [old records were still being digitised in Jinja](<https://www.monitor.co.ug/uganda/news/national/jinja-land-office-backlog-exposes-staffing-infrastructure-gaps-despite-digital-gains-5577014>). [Citizens can check land status and confirm ownership on the UgNLIS public portal](<https://media.gcic.go.ug/landowners-to-receive-freehold-titles-in-government-initiative/>), the lands minister said. No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

The minister said in November 2025 that [16,911,328 deeds documents are digitised and open to the public through eDRS](<https://pmg.org.za/committee-question/34341/>), live since 1 April 2025. Every deed registered since 2014 is electronic. In the last twelve months, in July 2026, [the minister gave a budget of R215 million for eDRS and R13.3 million to revamp the cadastral system](<https://pmg.org.za/committee-question/39709/>). SITA is to host eDRS. No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

[SMART Zambia Institute says ZILAS, the Zambia Integrated Land Administration System, is deployed and fully digital](<https://www.szi.gov.zm/?p=3792>). In March 2025 [ZILAS was generating digital title deeds with unique validation stamps](<https://buyingpropertyinzambia.com/2025/03/12/the-zambia-integrated-land-administration-system-progress-or-setback/>). In the last twelve months, [the Auditor General's report for 2025 found 982 property records missing](<https://zambianbusinesstimes.com/982-properties-vanish-after-zilmis-to-zilas-transition/>), which Zambian Business Times reported in October 2026 were lost in the move from the older ZILMIS system. No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. No source says how many land offices use ZILAS. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.

[Zimbabwe launched the Digital Land Administration Platform in May 2025 to process title deeds electronically](<https://newziana.co.zw/zimbabwe-launches-digital-platform-to-modernize-title-deed-processing/>). In the last twelve months, in August 2026, the minister said [three manual land databases had been merged into one digital platform](<https://spikedmedia.co.zw/land-tenure-reform-ensures-bankability-and-agricultural-investment/>). In November 2026 The Herald reported that [the One National e-Cadastre held over 80% of an estimated 1.3 to 1.4 million property records](<https://www.heraldonline.co.zw/new-digital-land-registry-captures-1m-properties-nears-launch/>). Its spatial records cover about 60% of the country. No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country. Operating would need the digital land register in service nationally or in all land offices.
